title: Cmd-Q and reopen with 60 workspaces: the shown terminals show their last screen in the first frame, never an empty pane, and are live within 1 s
why: Lawrence 2026-10-27 19:25 (handoff/restore-perf.md, restore-shot-2026-10-27-1925.png): cmux NIGHTLY relaunched with about 60 workspaces showed its three visible terminals as empty panes with a cursor box and 'Restoring...' for seconds: nothing usable on screen. Chrome's session restore shows the visible tab's last content at once and loads hidden tabs lazily. Guards the frame hold that gave up after 3 s (cp/restore-frame-hold) and every later restore regression.
source: restore-perf.md binding targets: last content in the first frame, no blank pane, no Restoring pill over a blank pane, visible terminals live within 300 ms warm / 1 s cold, hidden workspaces attach on first show
